batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b L Ngidi

batting.name: JM Bairstow
batting.dismissal: c DL Chahar b SM Curran

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c F du Plessis b L Ngidi

batting.name: MM Ali
batting.dismissal: c KM Jadhav b Rashid Khan

balls.text: swiped over the leg side for six. Jadhav finishes the innings with a six against his former team. He stretches out to this fullish ball on middle and muscles it over square leg for his first six since IPL 2019
Curran bangs a lifter outside off. Jadhav was shaping to swipe it away to the leg side, then changes his shot at the last moment, and ramps it over short third man for four
low full-toss outside off, pushed down to Thakur at wide long-off
Williamson jumps across off, offcutter from Curran, wide of the batter's reach and gets it to float past the outside edge
off-stump yorker, jammed out to the off side
low full-toss on middle, picked away to deep midwicket. Jadeja runs in, attacks the ball, and keeps it to one
Thakur closes out the over with a full-toss which is swiped to deep midwicket
slower-ball bouncer from Thakur, Kane Williamson reads the change-up. Leaps and ramps it over backward point
Kane jumps out, manufactures an off-stump full-toss and dispatches it away between midwicket and wide long-on
this is even better from Kane. Another artistic drive, he hits this with a slicing motion. The wide yorker is missed. Full and wide of off, he reaches out and pumps it over cover-point
shot, Kane! This is a full-toss, but still not easy to put away these low full-tosses. He shuffles across and whips it with the wrists over midwicket
former Super King Jadhav punches a length ball on middle to long-on
pumped over mid-off. This is a length ball outside off, Williamson plants his front leg, shows the full face of the bat and drives it artistically over mid-off

Incredible effort from du Plessis at wide long-on. He gives his team-mates a thumbs up. This one seems destined to sail over the boundary....until Faf dives to his right and plucks it out of thin air with both hands. He makes it look ridiculously easy. Even Jadeja loved it. Pitched up and outside off, as Ngidi misses his yorker, hauled away
smoked straight of long-off. Ngidi misses the yorker, serves up an on-pace slot ball. Belted through the line
Williamson rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and secures a single to backward point
another attempted yorker that comes out as a full-toss, heaved away into the leg side

Ngidi puts Warner out his misery. A tortured stay comes to an end. Ngidi aims for the wide yorker, comes out as a very full ball wide of off. Warner reaches out for the ball, loses his shape, and weakly carves it to Jadeja at sweeper cover. He holes out for 57 off 55
Warner steps out at him, he sprays it past the tramline. Off-side wide
low full-toss outside off, Warner can just slice it to sweeper cover
Thakur nails another yorker outside off, jammed more or less straight to Faf at long-on
full-toss outside off, swung away down the ground. It seems destined to roll into the boundary....until Faf throws himself to his right, slides, and stops the ball at long-on
wide yorker, well bowled, Thakur. Warner reaches out for the ball and carves to deep third man
wide yorker or rather a wide full-toss that defeats Warner outside off
mighty full and outside off, Pandey can't get underneath the length. Hauled to wide long-on
Warner feigns to back away, Jadeja darts it just wide of off. Warner jumps back in line and jabs it back to Jadeja

half-tracker on middle, Warner loads up and carts a six over midwicket. Right off the middle. Warner labours to 55 off 50 balls. Subdued celebrations. No trademark leap. Just a punch of the glove with Pandey. New ball, please
back of a length on off, eased to sweeper cover
another 99ks dart on top of off, defended
full and wide of off, 99.3ks, swished in the air, but does not carry to Raina diving forward from extra-cover
Warner backs away and hauls it away to deep square leg
short, wide, Warner makes room and slices to sweeper cover
pitched up on middle, Warner makes some room and pumps it over long-off for six. Relief for Warner as he looks skyward

Jadeja swoops to his left in the outfield and intercepts the ball. Ngidi pounds it on a hard length, short-armed away through midwicket. Warner has struggled in isolation tonight, but he becomes the fourth player, after Gayle, Pollard, and Malik to 10,000 runs in T20 cricket
Warner jumps across off, falls on the floor. This lifter bounces over the stumps as Warner swings desperately and misses
just short of a good length and angling in towards off stump, shovelled away to wide long-on off the back foot
Pandey shimmies out, Ngidi slides a length ball down the leg side. Wide called
just short of a good length and swerves in at Pandey just outside off, he looks to dink it down to third man...and misses
on the pads again, tickled away fine of short fine leg. Pandey marks his return with a 35-ball half-century
short and shoved down leg for a wide
speared wide of off, flat and quick, Pandey reaches out for the ball and under-edges it, nutmegging Dhoni for a fortunate four
darted around off, Warner drives along the ground to long-off
on the hips, glanced straight to short fine leg
on a length and outside off, Pandey reaches out for the ball and carves to backward point. A fumble allows the second. Pandey puts in a full-length dive and makes it
pushed through outside off, 101ks, forced to extra-cover
back of a length and angling into off, punched down to long-on
chipped in the air off a leading edge, but plops it wide of extra-cover
SRH find the boundary at long last. Cross-seamer outside off, down the track and belted straight of wide long-off
slower bouncer outside off, Pandey lets it go
back of a length and wide of off, slashed away to the left of sweeper cover for a double
dug in short and outside off, Pandey middles a pull, but Raina throws himself to his right at midwicket to intercept the ball
short on middle and leg, tucked more or less straight to Raina at short midwicket
Jadeja spears another dart into the pitch. Pandey uses his feet and hauls it away to deep midwicket. Both batters are struggling to find the boundary
short and attacking the top of the stumps, Warner falls over on the slog-sweep and drags the ball to deep midwicket
shorter and attached with more width outside off, Warner cuts behind point. Third man cuts it off
speared shorter and just a shade outside off, miscued to the left of Jadeja
on a length and sliding just across Warner, he sweeps weakly to short fine leg
short and darted into middle, Pandey punches off the back foot to long-on
slower ball, bounces over middle stump. 115ks cutter from Ngidi, Warner doesn't read the change-up. He swings for the hills and misses
back of a length and slanting into off, 139.2ks, Pandey hauls it away to wide long-on
banged in short and a lot closer to off, slapped to Gaikwad at sweeper cover

Warner finally hits it in the gap and punches gloves with Pandey. Ngidi errs short and wide of off. Warner shuffles across, throws his hands at the ball, and slices it away square through the off side
short and angling into the body, forced to the right of short cover. Faf tumbles and swoops down on the ball
overpitched and outside off, Warner stays leg-side of the ball and bashes it to the right of mid-off. Warner leaps and kicks the turf in frustration. He can't find the gap today
advances again but Moeen is aware of the threat he's facing now. Fires it in quick and at Warner's thigh, forcing him to squeeze it to long-on
does well to prevent the big hit does Moeen, as he spots Pandey coming down and pulls the length back just enough that the batter can only tap it down to long-on
tries to whip the slow, round the wicket delivery off his pads, but it hits his pads and goes to short fine leg
flatter and outside off, Pandey taps it to long-on
he's dancing down again and this time he has all the leverage he needs to launch a length ball on off stump away over midwicket. Full, fierce swing of the bat and we need a new ball
steps out to the tossed up ball outside off with a big swing, but can't beat Moeen
hard-length delivery outside off, stabbed to the right of Moeen at short cover
back of a length and slanting into middle, shovelled away between deep midwicket and wide long-on
shortish and some width, slashed to Gaikwad at sweeper cover
back of a length and snakes away like a fast legcutter, Warner gets into an awkward side-on position and is beaten on the outside edge
on a length and outside off, Warner stays leg-side of the ball and clatters it straight to mid-off
banged in short and outside off, Pandey hops and fends to deep third man
hard-length offbreak from Moeen on off, punched down to long-on off the back foot
flatter on middle and leg, driven with the wrists to Curran at wide long-on
middle-stump ball, short, Warner makes room and chops straight to backward point. Good defensive lines and lengths
fuller and breaks into middle, patted down to long-on off the front foot
sliding into the pads, on a length, a helmet-less Warner works it through square leg

looped up wide of off, full, drilled away to the right of sweeper. Gaikwad puts in a slide and swats the ball away to Curran running across to his left from wide long-off. Good tag-team work from the CSK boys
on a length and outside off, punched to mid-off for an urgent single
back of a length and slanting across off, Warner opens the bat-face and sweets it to sweeper cover
short again but closer to off this time and Thakur gets it to skid off the pitch. Toe-ends a cut to point
short and shoved down the leg side, this half-tracker is pulled away fine of long leg for four. Poor ball from Thakur and he cops punishment
just short of a good length and outside off, Pandey replies with another checked-punch to mid-off
dug in short on middle, swivel-pulled to long leg
bouncer from wide of the crease, gets big on Pandey and beats his hook
full-toss on the pads, Curran gets away with it. Warner can only clip it to Thakur's right at long leg
hard-length delivery on off. Curran and Chahar aren't offering Warner room. Stabbed into the covers
Curran comes back with a lifter outside off. Pandey arches his back and glides it to deep third man
laced away to the right of short extra-cover and left of mid-off. Back of a length and outside off, blameless delivery, Pandey checks his punch and puts it away in grand style
really full on middle and leg, not much swing, bunted down to long-on
short and too close to the body for the cut, Pandey chops it behind to the keeper
back of a length and on the hips, diverted away behind square on the leg side
on a length and outside off, tip and run to the off side
shortish and outside off, run away to backward point
short and outside off, the ball doesn't come on, so Pandey checks his cut and strokes it in the gap between backward point and cover-point
back of a length on middle, no room, Warner leans back and punches just wide of Moeen at backward point
on a length and outside off, bunted defensively to extra-cover
full inswinger from Curran, inside-edged onto the pad. The ball rolls behind
shortish and just a shade outside off, enough room for Warner to slash a cut past the right of sweeper cover
short of a length and holds its line outside off, flayed straight to extra-cover

Bairstow was itching to dash out of the crease against the seamers. Curran pushes him back with a quicker short ball. Bairstow can't quite control the pull. He splices it in the air. Chahar runs across to his left from square-ish long leg and snaffles it
Bairstow jumps out at his England team-mate, but he slips a slower full-toss down the leg side
Warner manufactures some swinging room, Curran follows him and keeps him to a dot to mid-off
tapped away to the right of Moeen at sweeper cover with an open bat-face
inswinger on the pads, clipped only as far as short midwicket
back of a length and nips back in to take the inside edge and sneak away to long leg
Bairstow shimmies out to Chahar and heaves this length ball away from outside off to the midwicket boundary
really full and swings back in at middle, punched between mid-off and covers
smeared over cover-point this time. Pitched up and moving away wide of off. Warner chucks his hands at the ball and slices it over the infield
veering into the pads, tickled away to fine leg
on a length and largely holds its line outside off, punched to the right of backward point. Good save from Gaikwad. Raina, who used to own that position back in his prime, gives Gaikwad a pat
back of a length and angling away outside off, guided to point
fullish and swinging away outside off, Warner allows the ball to come onto him, then runs it towards deep third man. A fumble from Chahar sees Warner get a double
thrashed straight to cover-point once again by Warner. Flashed so hard that the ball bursts out of Rayudu's hands. Jadeja hunts the ball down
back of a length and swinging back into the pads, Bairstow picks it away to long leg
short, wide, thrashed straight to Moeen at cover-point off the back foot
good-length inswinger from Chahar, Warner falls over the flick and wears it on the pad. This is heading down leg side
shorter and angling away from Warner again, but closer to off, jabbed up to point
even fuller and homing away wide of off, Warner shoulders arms once again
nice and full, angling across off, left alone in the channel. Finishes past the tramline, though

inswing for Chahar. Back of a length and homing in from over the wicket, Bairstow jumps across off, off the thigh pad and lobs behind to the left of Dhoni. He dives but the ball pops out of his gloves. Replays indicate that Bairstow had nicked it. So, that'll go down as a drop. Bairstow gets away with a single. Fairly regulation catch missed
hint of outswing for Chahar. Nice and full, angling away, moving further away, Warner inches forward and tips to cover for an urgent single
full-toss outside off, Raina stretches out and caresses it through the gap at extra-cover to seal victory for CSK
slower ball. Short, wide, scythed to sweeper cover
full on middle and leg, slower ball, hoicked to deep square
full-toss on middle, Raina has a roundhouse swipe at it and inside-edges it to fine leg
bouncer on leg stump, Raina swerves out of the way

full and veering into the pads, Raina picks it up and whips it in the air. It hangs in the air briefly, so Vijay runs in from deep midwicket, attacks the ball, dives forward for the catch. But the ball dips under his reach and rolls away into the fence
chipped in front of midwicket
Raina backs away outside leg, gets a full ball in his arc, as Kaul misses the yorker. Belted straight past the bowler
pretty full and outside off, pushed back to the right of the bowler
shortish offcutter outside off, punched into the covers
Raina backs away outside leg, Khaleel follows the moving batsman with a short ball. Hauled to midwicket
back of a length and on the hips, tucked to deep square leg
full-toss flung down the leg side for a wide
short and wide of off, stabbed out to point
Jadeja rocks into a back-foot pull and pummels it to the midwicket boundary. Hip-high short ball outside off, Jadeja sends it whistling in front of square
middle-stump yorker, Raina brings his bat down in time and jams it to point
pitched up and outside off, Raina presses forward and drives wide of mid-off
bouncer outside off, Raina hops across off and fends it off
on a length and running away outside off past the outside edge
bouncer on middle, Raina ducks under it
banged in short and outside off, pulled flat and hard to deep midwicket
full on the stumps, driven to mid-off

Rashid strikes again. Another googly, this time to the right-hander, fizzes in and pings the front pad as Faf plays for the legbreak and misses. He goes for a review. Ultra Edge confirms no bat involved. The tracker returns umpire's call on leg stump. Faf has to go
holes out to wide long-on. Rashid takes this wrong'un away from Moeen's swinging arc. He still goes for the slog and finds Jadhav
Moeen: Cool as. Dragged down on the hips, Moeen nonchalantly picks it up and swats it over square leg
on a length and breaks away outside off, jabbed through point with an open face
wrong'un, shorter and breaking away, slapped off the back foot to Vijay sweeping the off-side boundary
hip-high short ball outside off, Moeen lays into it and pulls powerfully over midwicket
leg-side wide
flicked off the hips to fine leg
lifter outside off, Moeen has his eyes locked on the ball before ducking under it
banged in short and gets high on Moeen, who flaps a pull into the leg side
first-ball four. He has always been a fast starter. Back of a length and too straight in line, flicked away past leg gully
full-toss outside off, slapped back to Khaleel who lets the ball burst through his hands

Rashid strikes back to knock over the off stump. Nevertheless, this is a fine knock from Gaikwad. Gaikwad plays for the googly/slider that would come into him, but this is the legbreak that turns away just enough to beat the outside edge and hit the off stump. Finally, some respite for SRH
another short one on the hips, Gaikwad gets into a sweeping position and ends up shovelling the ball through square leg with the bottom wrist
dropped short and sliding into the hips, not sure if it was the wrong'un. Anyway, it's too short. Gaikwad jumps back and hauls it over midwicket with a pull
pushed through on middle and leg, eased down to long-on
down the track and drilled through the line to sweeper cover
dipping legbreak, fizzes past the outside edge or rather grazes the outside edge and nutmegs Bairstow. Bairstow can't close his gloves around the ball. Difficult chance
pushed through on middle and leg, worked away to the right of the bowler
Gaikwad leans back to this short ball outside off and serenely punches through backward point. Pierces the gap once again
lobbed up outside off and spins away, Gaikwad goes inside out. He collapses his back knee and cracks it over extra-cover

pulled away between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Fifth IPL half-century for Gaikwad. Dragged down on middle, dispatched off the back foot. Gaikwad raises his bat, Chahar does the Whistle Podu from the dug out
Faf backs away outside leg and forces a length ball from outside off to long-off
flat and quick on middle, punched to the right of extra-cover

good length and slanting into middle, neatly picked off towards long leg. Another half-century for Faf - he is warmly applauded by his team-mates from the dug-out. A glove-punch from Gaikwad is also part of the celebrations
bouncer outside off, Faf top-edges a pull and skies it to the left of deep midwicket
shorter and outside off, Gaikwad jumps on top of the bounce and eases to the right of sweeper
back of a length and outside off, Gaikwad deftly steers to the right of deep third man. He comes back for the second
Faf rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and gets it to the right of deep third man
full and on middle and leg, neatly picked away behind square on the leg side
102ks legbreak, on an in-between length once again, this time Rashid goes past Faf's outside edge
shorter and spins away outside off, punched to Vijay at sweeper cover off the back foot
fizzing legbreak from Rashid, on an in-between length, zips past the outside edge
wrong'un from Rashid, but he drags it too short. Gaikwad rocks into a back-foot pull and hits it over midwicket
flat and fast on middle and leg, whipped away to wide long-on
low full-toss on off, pushed down to long-off
hauled away to the left of long-on. The outfielder was in a dilemma whether to attack the ball or hang back. Down the track and put away straight of Pandey
Faf uses his feet again, Suchith held this back and shortened the length. Faf checks his shot and pushes to short cover
hoisted over long-on. Faf dashes out of he crease, meets a full ball on middle early and dispatches it over the outfielder
fuller and angling into the pads, glanced away through square leg
shortish and around off, Gaikwad jumps deep in the crease and punches it handsomely to the left of sweeper
Shot, Gaikwad! He shimmies outside leg and out of the crease, Suchith chases him with a slider. Still, Gaikwad drops down to one knee and caresses it through extra-cover
sliding into off, Faf covers the line and blocks solidly to short cover
slower through the air on middle, eased down to long-off off the front foot
short and outside off, Faf stands tall and punches to long-on again
pushed down the leg side, clipped away to deep square leg
wrong'un, short of a length and finishes on middle, forced down to long-on off the back foot
back of a length and sliding into off, Faf camps back and whisks it to short midwicket
veering into the pads, glanced away fine of long leg
one-bounce four! Fractionally short and angling in around off, he jumps back, gets quickly into position and swats it over midwicket
good length and sliding into middle, played back to Suchith
Gaikwad leans back to this short ball that turns away and deftly steers it in front of square on the off side
Gaikwad runs down the track, meets a full ball early and whips it with the incoming angle over midwicket
tossed up on middle, this non-turner is tapped down to long-on
length ball on middle, driven to Suchith at cover-point
slower ball, dips on middle, worked through square leg. Another fifty opening stand between Faf and Gaikwad
chipped in the air to the right of midwicket
full on the stumps, eased down to long-on
slower variation, sliced in the air, but bounces in front of mid-off. Replays suggest this was the knuckle ball from Sandeep
belted away between extra-cover and mid-off once again. Back of a length and holds its line outside off, he punches it on the up with immense authority
Attacking intent from Gaikwad. Down the track and hauled away to the left of deep midwicket for a double.
on-pace, back of a length and angling into a leg-side flick more or less straight to midwicket
thrashed between extra-cover and mid-off. Slower ball on a back of a length and outside off, Faf gives himself some swinging room and puts it away in grand style
driven to the left of mid-on. Gaikwad takes on Williamson's arm, I think, for a single
full on the stumps, Gaikwad flows forward and drives straight to mid-on
edged but between Bairstow and short third man. On a length and largely holds its line outside off, Gaikwad searches for the cover-drive and nicks it away
back of a length and outside off, yet another offcutter, Gaikwad hangs back and punches sweetly to sweeper on the off side

slower ball outside off, Faf delays the drive and dinks it to point. Williamson swoops down on the ball in the infield and throws down the stumps at the non-striker's end but Faf has grounded his bat in time
back of a length and slanting into off stump, defensively worked to short midwicket
slower cutter, grips in the surface, jabbed back to him
shortish and veering in from wide of the crease, Faf belatedly opens the bat-face and steers this cutter past the right of Bairstow and left of short third man
Wow, those hands from Faf! Short and wide of off, Faf stays leg-side of the ball and crunnnnnnnches it through point
fullish on middle, possibly a slower ball, played back to Sandeep
pitched up and angling into off, smoothly driven down to long-on off the front foot
slower ball, shortish and outside off, Gaikwad delays his punch down to long-on
full and holds its line outside off, forward and driven to Vijay Shankar at short extra-cover
edged past leg stump and the right of Bairstow for four. Gaikwad ventures outside leg, Sandeep chases the moving batsman. He chucks his bat at ball and gets away
full and swings into middle, Gaikwad elects to play back and work it with the swing to midwicket
takes the pace off, which is a good idea against a batter charging you, and keeps it wide of his reach. Faf loses his shape trying to reach as far a he can outside off. Doesn't connect

whacks it to the extra cover boundary. That's vintage Faf. The race down the track. The balance. And then the genius in his hands. He extends them and somehow always powers the ball away. Other batters just nick off.
carves a length ball outside off to the left of short cover
pulls the short ball cramping him to the right of short midwicket. Doesn't look comfortable with the shot, but manages to get two in the end.
rocks back and slaps a short ball outside off to the sweeper
mis-hits a length ball slanting across him to mid-off. Goes too hard at it and loses his shape.
good length ball outside off, pushes solidly to short cover. Nice sound off the bat
too far outside off to interest the batter
smooth drive to short cover, and there's so much timing on it that Vijay Shankar really does feel the sting of that ball striking his hand as it thuds into him and then deflects away to mid-off
pushes a back of a length delivery seaming into him to the sweeper
steps out to try and counter the movement, but Sandeep pulls his length back and keeps him to a dot to cover
plenty of inswing and Gaikwad is circumspect against it
there is swing! Gaikwad is playing around his front pad a little bit as the fuller delivery curls into him and he hits it to deep midwicket
